fact: Malawi's government announced it is drafting legislation to regulate the use of AI, addressing concerns over potential ethical risks, with ICT minister Shadric Namalomba saying the bill should be tabled in parliament before December 2026.

Malawi's ICT ministry says a National AI Strategy will be supported by an AI Bill establishing a regulatory framework to promote innovation while safeguarding citizen privacy and ensuring operational accountability, per minister Shadric Namalomba.
Malawi24 reports that the Copyright Society of Malawi announced it would not register or distribute royalties for works created entirely using AI.
